name: Birthday Visit
source:
What do you do when your child is visiting on their birthday that you totally forgot?! Microwave your child's birthday meal to perfection, navigate through tense conversations, and pay close attention to select a gift they'll love! Can you restore your relationship with your child? Or will you destroy what's left?

[From [url=https://gamegoobers.itch.io/birthday-visit]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当你的孩子来访时，你完全忘记了他们的生日，你会怎么做？用微波炉完美地烹制孩子的生日大餐，应对紧张的对话，并密切注意选择他们喜欢的礼物！你能修复和孩子的关系吗？或者你会毁掉剩下的东西吗？

[来自[url=https://gamegoobers.itch.io/birthday-visit]itch.io[/url]]
